acceptance_criteria: Every quarantine transition persists a bounded disposition with provider-call possibility, delivery mutation state, replay policy, operator action, severity, and evidence coverage.
Stale status disposal and unreconstructable records remain fail-closed no-send outcomes and never emit an ambiguous-delivery or message-loss claim.
Unsafe ambiguous delivery retains a distinct delivery-risk incident and cannot be cleared by unrelated connectivity evidence.
Health exposes aggregate bounded counts by consequence without identity, content, provider prose, or topology.
Mixed contributors share one onset and clear contract; resolving one class neither clears another nor lets harmless retained rows hold a loss incident open.
Legacy rows are unclassified without prose parsing, and retention or acknowledgement cannot create a fresh incident or false recovery.
blast_radius: Outbound pending drain, status-operation TTL, durability schema, restart recovery, health aggregation, alert routing and clearing, operator retirement, terminal retention, monitoring, and runbook procedures.

The status-notice branch runs before provider send and is intentionally no-send, while runbook text describes positive quarantine as lost messages. falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified if every quarantined transition persisted a bounded consequence and provider-mutation classification, health and alert consumers selected behavior from that class, and onset and clear shared one contributor-aware predicate. Exact source disproves those conditions. Implementation must still establish policy for each consequence, mixed contributors, legacy rows, acknowledgement, retention, and operator action.
impact: Harmless pre-send disposal can be reported as user-visible message loss, genuine ambiguity is indistinguishable from data incompatibility, and contradictory clear rules can leave operators and automation treating the same retained rows as both recovered and incident-active.
